description: Heritage `value of … for key` on a TURTLE container raises the byte-identical Core `ol-type` the dotted `:t.tom` selector raises — `expected: "dict"`, `operation: "field"` (`spec/conformance.md:150`: alternate spellings only, no new semantics). Completes issue #784's enumeration of the non-dict container types: `turtle` needs the Sprites profile to reach (`who` reports the addressed turtle, `spec/turtles-and-sprites.md:44`), which is exactly why it was missing from the corpus, and a type nobody can write a fixture for by accident is a type the next divergence can hide in. The `value` param is the turtle itself, whose printed identity is its stable id. NO Heritage spelling in any payload (`operation` is the Core `"field"`, never `"value of"` — issue #670). The span points at the reader's `:t` operand (localization-only difference — `spec/localization.md`). Sprites depends on Turtle & Rendering, and Heritage on Data (`spec/conformance.md:305`), so all five profiles are active.

diagnostics.message: field needs a dict, but got a turtle.
